items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Grundsteuerwert-Fortschreibungsbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Musterweilburg eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter states a separate 'Aufgabe zur Post' (posting) date of Saturday, 21.11.2026, which overrides the printed Bescheid date (18.11.2026) as the start of the delivery-fiction count. For a tax office, delivery is deemed on the 4th calendar day after posting (§122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO), and if that 4th day falls on a weekend/holiday it moves to the next working day (§108 Abs.3 AO). Counting from Sat 21.11.2026: day1=Sun22.11, day2=Mon23.11, day3=Tue24.11, day4=Wed25.11.2026 — a normal working day, so deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) = 25.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO, counted per §108 Abs.1 AO/§188 Abs.2 BGB) runs from the delivery day (not counted) and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 25.12.2026. However 25.12. (1. Weihnachtstag) and 26.12. (2. Weihnachtstag) are nationwide public holidays, and 27.12.2026 is a Sunday; under §108 Abs.3 AO the period end moves to the next working day, which is Monday, 28.12.2026.

warnings: The letter states the posting ('Aufgabe zur Post') date as Saturday, 21.11.2026, which is unusual since German tax offices normally do not post mail on a Saturday; this printed date was nonetheless used as instructed by the delivery-fiction rules, but it may be worth double-checking the actual postmark if available.

This Bescheid only sets the new Grundsteuerwert (184,300 €); it does not itself demand any payment — the actual Grundsteuer amount will follow in a separate Grundsteuermessbescheid/municipal assessment, so no payment item was created from this letter.
